strings.同时攻击防御最高的两个单位: Attacks two units with the highest DEF simultaneously
strings.【大潮】对所有我方单位造成法术和神经损伤: [Great Tide] Deals Arts damage and Nervous Impairment to all allied units
strings.【崩坍】对若干我方单位造成物理伤害: [Collapse] Deals Physical damage to multiple allied units
strings.【断裂生殖】召唤子代缠绕我方单位使其晕眩: [Fragmentation] Summons its offspring to entwine themselves around allied units and Stun them
strings.【物种爆发】战斗经过较长时间后扣除所有目标生命: [Species Outbreak] Drains all Life Points after a long time has passed in the battle
strings.未被阻挡时有几率闪避物理与法术攻击，被阻挡时可以快速移动至其身后并在原地留下一个: Has a chance to dodge Physical and Arts attacks when not blocked. When blocked, swiftly moves behind the target and leaves an <Ominous Apparition> at the original location
strings.会使用技能对周围造成物理伤害，攻击和技能无视目标一定防御力且额外造成神经损伤: Can use skills to deal Physical damage to the surrounding area; attacks and skills ignore a certain amount of DEF and inflict Nervous Impairment
